title: A FORGE UPGRADE RAISES NO WEAPON CARD
why: His words 10-31: after i upgrade a weapon, i do not need to see a weapon card; it should only show when mousing over the weapon in the hotbar. The Forge upgrade set G.gunCard, which popped the new gun against the old with the cost. It sets nothing now. The sparks, the upgrade sound, the ping and the gun upgraded line stay, and the hotbar hover card is unchanged.
now: No weapon card after an upgrade; hover the hotbar to see it.

edits.anchor: G.gunCard={gk:nw.id,w:nw,vs:w,route:'cost '+forgeMoney(o.cost),t0:G.t||0};   // v28.xx (cw-cx-forgeread): name the debit as the upgrade cost.
edits.replacement: // v28.xx (cw-no-gun-card), HIS WORDS (2026-10-31): "after i upgrade a weapon, i don't need to see a weapon card. The only time a weapon card should show up is when mousing over the weapon in the hotbar". The upgrade used to set G.gunCard (the new gun against the old, "cost $N"); it sets nothing now. The sparks, the upgrade sound, the ping and the "gun upgraded" line stay; the card shows on the hotbar hover (beltHoverHud).
